title: Loot chest

# Loot chest

# Introduction

A loot chest functions like regular chest, but is spawned at World Creation at a certain point of interest and contains loot appropriate to the biome where it appears, and sometimes treasure than can be used to barter with Haldor.

• Amount: 1 | Item: Amber | Chance: 16.7%

• Amount: 5-15 | Item: Coins | Chance: 16.7%

• Amount: 1-3 | Item: Feathers | Chance: 16.7%

### Troll Cave Chest

There could be more than 1 chest in the cave
Also there's loot on the floor:
Up to 9 treasures with 50% spawn each containing one of:
• 1-3 Amber pearl
• 1-2 Ruby
• 1-5 Amber
• 5-20 Coins
Up to 12 Yellow mushrooms with 50% chance each.
